Name: Build Endurance Resurrected
Author: Zerashk07
Description:
Level up your endurance to increase your max stamina as you play.
[b]Full credit goes to [/b][url=http://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Omegasis?gameId=1303]Alpha_Omegasis[/url], this is their [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/445?tab=description]mod[/url]!

After playing without it for so long I patched it to work with SV 1.6. The 'trained stamina' you earn is now applied as an invisible buff, this should result in fewer conflicts and instances of Build Endurance 'eating' other Max Stamina increases (like Stardrops)

I'm a software engineer, but this is literally my first Stardew mod, so please go easy on me, and use the Bugs page to let me know what I've broken.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
To undo the mod's changes later, edit the data\*.json file for your save and change the [i]ClearModEffects [/i]field to true.

[size=5]Usage[/size]
You'll automatically get XP for...
[list]
[*]using tools;
[*]sleeping;
[*]eating or drinking;
[*]running out of stamina (becoming exhausted);
[*]passing out (either by working while exhausted or or staying up late).
[/list]
Get enough XP, and your endurance will level up and increase your max stamina.
